calls.reconciliation: The factual dispute was the guidance track record: Run 3 said Q3FY26 came in above the top of guidance, but the dossiers' own numbers put it at +16.4% YoY, inside Run 2's 14-17% guide. Q2FY26 (+16.6% vs 13-16%) and Q1FY26 (+15.7% vs 10-12%) beat the top; Q4FY25 (+7.9% vs 8-10%) was at the low end. The pattern is a typical beat of ~1.5-4% over the guide midpoint, with the one low-end result in a prior September quarter. The judgment calls were how much the heavier supply limits and the Oct iPhone order-cut reports dampen the beat: they are mostly December-quarter effects and the supply limits are already in the guide, so I took a modest beat (~1.2-1.5%) => median $114.0B, inside the $113.4-115.3B consensus band. Run 2's 20% chance below $112B is too high given Apple rarely misses the low end of its guide; I set it at 7%. The report date (Nov 2) is inside the window. No market was found by any run; I had no web access this run. I agree with the runs' reference class.
